scripture.text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

sayings.translation: A person's worth is measured by how they treat other people.

sayings.text: Usiache kesho kile unachoweza kufanya leo kwa moyo wote.
sayings.translation: Do not leave for tomorrow what you can do today with your whole heart.

sayings.text: Keep the fire going. Every family needs someone who keeps the fire going.

values: Faithfulness in prayer, in season and out of season
The homestead as a place of welcome for all family
Hard work on the land as a form of worship
Elder respect as the foundation of family order
Generosity as daily practice, not occasional charity

archiveStatement.en: This memorial site will remain as a living archive of Peris Basweti's life and legacy. We invite family to return here on her anniversary, to add memories, and to let future generations know who she was and what she stood for.
archiveStatement.sw: Ukurasa huu wa kumbukumbu utabaki kama hazina ya maisha na urithi wa Peris Basweti. Tunaalika familia kurudi hapa siku ya kumbukumbu yake, kuongeza kumbukumbu, na kuwaruhusu vizazi vya baadaye kujua alikuwa nani na alichoamini.
archiveStatement.guz: Ericha rino ry'engoro rikaara nk'ebitabu by'obomi na obosani bwa Peris Basweti. Twaganira abe baye bagaruke aha omwaka omwaka, baongere engoro, na bareete abana b'ebiturire bamenye aye naari na gaki yaakoria.
